## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:

- `network_id` (String, Optional) Only return servers of this network.

## Attribute Reference

In addition to the arguments above, the following attributes are exported:

- `id` (String)
- `servers` (List of Object) Servers found.
  - `disks` (List of Object)
    - `size_gb` (Number)
  - `id` (String)
  - `name` (String)
